Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This is an immunopeptidomics study. Reanalysis requires an 'unspecific' enzyme setting in the search engine to capture the naturally processed HLA-bound peptides, as they do not follow standard tryptic cleavage.

acquisition: data was acquired in data dependent acquisition (DDA) mode, using a Top20 method
quantification: proteins LFQ intensity were Log-2 transformed
specialized: HLA-I molecules were immunoaffinity purified from cleared lysate with the pan-HLA-I antibody (W6/32 antibody purified from HB95 hybridoma cells) covalently bound to Protein-A Sepharose beads
HLA-II molecules were then purified by transferring the flow-through to similar affinity columns containing a pan-HLA-II antibody (purified from HB-145 hybridoma cells)

MStype_prompt.notes: The experiment consists of two parts: HLA peptidomics (immunopeptidomics) and a general proteomic analysis of the flow-through. The primary goal and the specific enrichment described are for the immunopeptidome. Search parameters for the general proteomics part included oxidation of methionine.
